$description: Density-dependent sizes, comfortable by default. The compact mode overrides these; setting data-density on <html> retunes every control.

height.$description: Height of buttons, inputs, selects, and other single-line controls. Comfortable 36 px, compact 28 px.
Height of table and list rows. Comfortable 32 px, compact 24 px; never below the 24 px target size (WCAG 2.5.8).

inline.$description: Inline (left and right) padding inside controls.
Inline padding inside table cells and list items.

inset.$description: Padding inside panels, cards, and dialogs.
